items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: We had a boy called Sondheim(?) on drums, Glyn Paque, myself, and we did...we played there

ctx.x: He was my trumpet player. He said, "I know you. I was your trumpet player." They have like a county fair, sponsored I think by Norelco -- their factory is in Einholden. Helleman(?) is close to it. Well, the band was in my name with Alpha(?) Pay(?). We had a boy called Sondheim(?) on drums, Glyn Paque, myself, and we did...we played there, I remember, in Einholden and Helleman(?)...

Now, from there we were supposed to meet Bobby. That means we had to take a train, to go through Germany all up to Denmark. We had to pass a good deal of time. So in the inside... I remember Glyn Paque had this thing and had magazines from home. At that time there was...called Ken(?) Magazine, and Ken(?) Magazine had a headline, "Nazis Try To Kidnap Joe Louis." And we have this magazine. So I said, "Look, we're going through Germany, man. You'd better get..." -- you know. He says, "Aw..." So, sure enough, people…
